q: How many orders are there in total?

gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

q: Top 5 product categories by GMV in English
gold: SELECT pc.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.price) g FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN product_categories pc ON pc.product_category_name=p.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY g DESC LIMIT 5

q: What is the average review score?
How many unique customers are there?
How many sellers are in each state?
gold: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM sellers GROUP BY 1

q: What is the most used payment type by total payment value?
gold: SELECT payment_type FROM order_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(payment_value) DESC LIMIT 1
